rationale: Zone 1 set to 80% of protected line impedance (26.388 ohms) for underreach. Zone 2 covers line plus 55% of shortest backup (L_BC=15.743 ohms). Zone 3 covers line plus 122.5% of longest backup (L_BD=18.561 ohms), well below the 80% load encroachment limit (121 ohms). Delays set to median values within coordination windows.
